propositions: Compaction writes untracked SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired files non-atomically in a detached sweep without rollback, leaving the tracker working tree dirty on worker death or timeout
When reconverge runs git merge origin/tickets, it aborts if origin has introduced those same untracked paths, with error 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge'
The current abort-only handler and push-recovery mechanism (git reset --hard, git stash without -u) cannot clear untracked files, causing permanent wedge and stranding local commits off origin
The fix detects the untracked-collision abort signature, relocates only the named untracked paths to a quarantine directory outside the worktree, and retries the merge once to restore both parents
Real event appends (.tmp-event-* at tracker root) are unaffected because they do not exist on origin and are never named by git's error message
Tracked .archived file deletions left by interrupted compaction remain dirty in subsequent operations, causing plan-review and completion-verification gates to fail on store-read-failure
